name: supplier-ranking-demo
description: Browser-local supplier matching and ranking demo with hard constraints, transparent utility scoring, and deterministic explanations.

paragraphs: An interactive, browser-local decision-support demo that turns sourcing requirements into a transparent supplier shortlist. It separates mandatory eligibility rules from preference scoring so users can see why a supplier qualifies, why another is excluded, and how each priority affects the final ranking.
This is an independent portfolio demonstration built with fictional data. It is not a production procurement system, supplier-discovery service, allocation optimizer, or purchasing recommendation.
Uploaded files are parsed locally in the browser. The application has no backend, database, analytics, authentication, or intentional upload of supplier data to another service.
features: Load a built-in dataset of 24 fictional suppliers or upload a compatible CSV.
Apply hard requirements for region, certifications, capacity, lead time, and quality.
Compare Balanced, Cost, Speed, and Risk scenarios or edit individual weights.
Inspect criterion utility scores, weighted contributions, and observed influence.
Review deterministic strengths, trade-offs, and complete exclusion reasons.
